background_rule: Any time not covered by a segment is BACKGROUND.

label_meaning.COVER: put the case side cover back on
label_meaning.FIXING_FAN: mount a fan (CPU cooler or case fan) in its place
label_meaning.INSERT: put a part in (motherboard, CPU, RAM stick, power supply, drive)
label_meaning.OPEN: open a latch or lever (e.g. RAM clip, CPU socket lever)
label_meaning.PLUG: connect a power or data cable
label_meaning.PLUG_FAN: connect a fan cable to the motherboard
label_meaning.SCREW: drive screws in with the screwdriver
label_meaning.UNCOVER: take the case side cover off
label_meaning.UNPLUG: disconnect a power or data cable
label_meaning.UNSCREW: take screws out with the screwdriver

segments.label: INSERT
segments.note: Motherboard picked up from the left, lowered into the case and lined up.

segments.label: SCREW
segments.note: Motherboard screws driven in one after another; the short reaches to the table for the next screw are included.

segments.label: INSERT
segments.note: Hand at the socket just before the cooler goes on; most likely the CPU going in. The socket lever is probably lifted before (OPEN) and pressed down after (CLOSE); split those out if you can see them.

segments.label: FIXING_FAN
segments.note: CPU cooler with its fan put on the processor and fastened down (the screwing near the end could also be SCREW).

segments.label: FIXING_FAN
segments.note: Rear case fan picked up and held in place at the back of the case.

segments.label: SCREW
segments.note: Screws driven into the rear case fan.

segments.label: INSERT
segments.note: RAM stick pressed into its slot next to the CPU (was PLUG_FAN in the first draft).

segments.label: INSERT
segments.note: Power supply picked up, placed in the case and lined up.

segments.label: PLUG
segments.note: Power and data cables connected to the board and the drives (red SATA cable around 498-515 s).

segments.label: COVER
segments.note: Side cover put back on and slid shut.
